# AnimeOutline

> > Step-by-step drawing tutorials teaching anime and manga art fundamentals, from facial expressions and character design to anatomy and styling techniques.

AnimeOutline provides comprehensive beginner-friendly tutorials for aspiring anime and manga artists, covering essential skills like eye drawing, facial expressions, hair styles, body anatomy, and character accessories. The site features detailed step-by-step guides with illustrations and video tutorials to help artists master the anime art style.

## Key Topics

- Anime eye drawing techniques
- Facial expressions and emotions
- Character design fundamentals
- Step-by-step drawing tutorials
- Manga art style
- Anime facial proportions
- Hair drawing and styling
- Beginner-friendly guides
- Color theory for anime
- Chibi style
- Body anatomy and poses
- Anime accessories and props
- Video tutorials
- Line art and shading techniques

## Facial Features & Expressions

- [12 Anime Facial Expressions Chart & Drawing Tutorial](https://www.animeoutline.com/12-anime-facial-expressions-chart-drawing-tutorial): Chart and tutorial for 12 common anime facial expressions with examples
- [8 Step Anime Woman's Face Drawing Tutorial](https://www.animeoutline.com/anime-woman-face-drawing-tutorial): 8-step tutorial for drawing anime woman's face with facial proportions
- [How to Draw Different Types of Anime Eyes](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-different-types-of-anime-eyes): Tutorial covering common, realistic, and chibi anime eye styles
- [How to Draw Angry Anime or Manga Eyes (8 Steps)](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-angry-anime-eyes): 8-step tutorial for drawing angry anime eyes from sketch to shading
- [How to Draw Scared Anime or Manga Eyes](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-scared-anime-or-manga-eyes): 8-step guide with video for drawing scared anime eyes expression
- [How to Draw Closed, Closing & Squinted Anime Eyes](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-closed-squinted-anime-eyes): Guide for drawing closed and squinted anime eyes with eyelid positions
- [How to Draw Freckles on Anime Faces](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-freckles-on-anime-faces): Quick tutorial showing different methods for drawing freckles on anime faces

## Hair & Character Styling

- [How to Draw Anime & Manga Male & Female Hair](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-anime-manga-male-female-hair): Hair drawing guide covering multiple views and styles for both genders
- [How to Draw Anime Hats & Head Ware](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-anime-hats): Tutorial with 12 examples of different anime hats and headwear styles
- [How to Draw Anime & Manga Glasses](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-anime-glasses): Guide for drawing anime-style glasses with placement and reflections

## Body Anatomy & Character Types

- [How to Draw Anime Muscular Male Body Step by Step](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-anime-muscular-male-body-step-by-step): Step-by-step guide for drawing muscular male anatomy in anime/manga style
- [How to Draw Anime Cat Girl (15 Steps With Video)](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-anime-cat-girl-ears-step-by-step): 15-step cat girl drawing tutorial with animal ears and video guide
- [How to Draw Toes & Toenails on a Foot in 4 Steps](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-toes-toenails-on-a-foot-in-4-steps): 4-step tutorial for drawing toes and toenails in 3/4 view

## Color & Technique Fundamentals

- [Guide to Picking Colors When Drawing Anime & Manga](https://www.animeoutline.com/beginner-guide-to-picking-colors-when-drawing-anime-manga): Comprehensive color theory guide for anime/manga with color combinations

## Props, Objects & Animals

- [How to Draw an Anime Cat Step by Step](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-an-anime-cat-step-by-step): 12-step breakdown for drawing anime-style cats and kittens
- [How to Draw Anime Style Food & Lunch Box](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-anime-food-lunchbox): Tutorial for drawing Japanese bento lunch box with anime-style food items
- [How to Draw a Gun in 15 Steps (Handgun)](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-a-gun-step-by-step): 15-step handgun drawing tutorial with cel-shading techniques
- [How to Draw a Shuriken (Ninja Star) Video Tutorial](https://www.animeoutline.com/how-to-draw-a-shuriken-ninja-star-video-tutorial): 6-step video tutorial for drawing shuriken with line art and coloring
